title: No More Random Cards: Kiosk Hunts for a Scene | vitalii.no
description:
Previews for Kunst og håndverk and Musikk on the TV wall never carried more than a topic name to dramatize, yet the scene generator kept trying to write one anyway — wasted work on every single one of them. Meanwhile the three oldest drill types, plan topics, word cards and maths, had a real scene less than half the time, and the kiosk picked the next card completely at random, so a kid could sit through several plain cards in a row before a scripted scene finally showed up.

I taught workers/shared/sceneScript.js to return no scene at all when a plan gives only a topic name, closing the gap for those two subjects. For the older three card types I added EXPLAIN-style scenes on every other card via scripts/home-pc/scenes/scenes_run.py and prompt_scene.md, raising the scene runner's daily output. On the kiosk side, LearningBoard's walk logic now actively hunts for a card that already has a scripted scene on the Matte, Norsk and Engelsk steps, instead of just picking the next card in line.

Previews with nothing to show no longer trigger a wasted generation attempt, the three oldest drill types went from occasional scenes to one on every other card, and the kiosk now refuses to repeat a card within forty-five minutes.
